name: sales-and-funding-assets
description: Sokogate Sales & Funding Agent — full-stack: agent, backend API, react dashboard

scripts.dev:all: npm:run dev:agent --workspace agent" "npm run dev --workspace backend" "npm run dev --workspace frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:all --workspace frontend && npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace agent
scripts.infra:up: concurrently -n db,redis -c green,cyan "npm run db:up" "docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.db.yml up -d redis"
scripts.infra:clean: npm run infra:down && docker volume prune -f
